newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Jan 9.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Jan 9.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
Pasminco buys Century Zinc project in Queensland from CRA-RTZ for A$345 million.
New South Wales supreme court judge Kim Santow to hand down ruling today on the scheme of arrangement to merge Advance Bank and St George.

Electrical and furniture retailer joins others in sector citing depressed retail environment. The company said on Wednesday it was trailing behind its target for 15 percent annual sales growth and that cool summer weather had impacted on December sales. Managing director Michael Harvey said the retail trading environment was the worst in the company's history, although he hoped the second half of the current year ending June 30 would compensate for a slow first half.
